description: Bind this assistant to the user's Decionis Shield with the six-character pairing code shown in the Shield app (AI spending allowance → Bind your own agent). Ask the user for the code; never guess one. After pairing, shield.request_purchase and the other shield.* tools ask the user's own spending rules.

code.description: The code from the Shield app.

displayName.description: How the Shield app should list this assistant (default: the client and this computer).

name: shield.pair
title: Pair with the user's Shield
